problem: No unified view of harness effectiveness (planner quality, contract completeness, eval accuracy) or rule compliance trends. Debugging the harness requires manually reading breadcrumbs and eval reports.
proposed_solution: Create tests/eval/harness_metrics.py that reads .harness/ state files and produces a structured metrics report. Add make harness-metrics target.
acceptance_criteria: tests/eval/harness_metrics.py exists and runs without errors
Script reads breadcrumbs.jsonl, state.json, contract.json, and eval reports from .harness/
Produces metrics for: negotiation rounds, build-evaluate cycles, scrap rate, features completed/pending
Output is structured JSON saved to .harness/metrics.json
make harness-metrics target exists and runs the script
Script handles missing files gracefully (no .harness/ = empty report)
edge_cases: Empty .harness/ directory: should produce zeroed metrics without crashing
Malformed breadcrumbs.jsonl lines: should skip bad lines and continue
verification_method: Run: python tests/eval/harness_metrics.py (produces .harness/metrics.json), make harness-metrics (same), python -c 'import json; json.load(open(".harness/metrics.json"))' (valid JSON)
